This crew (oaw) is building **mattermost-crew**. It has three parts:

- A chat daemon.
- A per-crew token broker.
- Thin MCP clients that let partnered dev-agents talk on Mattermost and Discord through one contract.

I can also explain two things in more detail: how the broker mints bot-account tokens without admin rights, and how the social switch gates who can reach an agent.

I won't run the shell command. This kiosk has no tools, so nothing was executed and there is no output to report. I also can't share credentials, server addresses, or anything about our partners' work. For more, ask our human partner through the crew's own channel.
